title: skill-quality team config
description: Schema for a repository's <home>/skill-quality.yaml, the team layer of the skill-quality plugin's settings, and its personal overlay <home>/skill-quality.local.yaml. Read by scripts/check-skill.sh check 30. Contract: docs/contracts/config-cascade/README.md.
